title: Percy Jackson Season 3 Starts with a Monster Fight in a Parking Garage!
summary: Imagine you're at Comic-Con, surrounded by fans in costumes, when suddenly the lights dim and you're watching the very first scene of Percy Jackson Season 3! That's exactly what happened when Disney+ shared the opening minutes of the new season. It kicks off with Thalia Grace, daughter of Zeus, battling a monster in a dark parking garage. Percy Jackson rushes in to help, but Thalia snaps, "I don't need your help!" They still manage to defeat the creature together. Then Annabeth appears and reveals she asked Percy to come because they need Thalia's help to rescue two new demigods—Nico and Bianca di Angelo—and bring them to Camp Half-Blood. But Percy isn't thrilled about teaming up with Thalia. The two have been butting heads since last season, and Percy even says he doesn't want her along. Before they can argue more, Thalia speeds away in a car. The season is based on the book "The Titan's Curse," and star Walker Scobell says it's the most book-accurate adaptation yet. That means fans of the books will see their favorite moments come to life just like they imagined. New characters include Levi Chrisopulos as Nico, Olive Abercrombie as Bianca, and even Kate McKinnon as Aphrodite! With Season 2 having just wrapped up in January, fans are getting a double dose of Percy this year. Get ready for more monsters, magic, and mythology when Season 3 hits Disney+.
why_it_matters: If you love action and Greek myths, this new season gives you a chance to see brave kids working together—something you might do with your own friends.

background_read: The Percy Jackson TV series is based on the popular books by author Rick Riordan, who created the world of Camp Half-Blood.
In the stories, demigods are half‑god, half‑human kids who train at Camp Half‑Blood to fight mythical creatures.
Season 3 adapts the third book, The Titan’s Curse, where Percy and friends face a dangerous new quest.
Article_Structure: WHO: Thalia Grace, Percy Jackson, Annabeth, and two new demigods, Nico and Bianca di Angelo.
WHAT: Percy and Thalia fight a monster, then Annabeth asks for their help to rescue Nico and Bianca and bring them to Camp Half-Blood.
WHERE: The scene takes place in a dark parking garage, and the clip was shown at Comic-Con.
WHY: Because a new season is coming, and the story follows the book 'The Titan's Curse'.

perspectives.description: Fans of the books are happy because the show is following the story closely, and they get to see favorite characters like Thalia and Nico come to life.
Some people think Percy and Thalia’s arguing slows down the action and hope the season doesn’t disappoint compared to the books.
